## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (it becomes the changelog entry)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run e2e` pass
- [ ] Docs are updated (README, `docs/DECISIONS.md`) if behaviour or design changed
- [ ] Screenshots or a recording are attached for UI changes
